newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable, overnight money tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable, overnight money tumbles.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in late trading on Monday, dealers said.
One local bank dealer trading in the spot market was slow, with focus seen mainly in the money market which saw overnight money tumble to a possible historic low of 0.5 percent.
Dealers said the absence of overnight bilateral papers (SBIs) and value today trading left no alternative to operators as to dump the rupiah into the money market.
The central bank injected some 1.81 trillion rupiah into the market in the morning on Monday.
The local bank dealer said overnight and tom/next swaps might fall into the negative zone again on Tuesday if liquidity remained ample on Tuesday.
"We don't have it for some time, the negative swaps. The only reason why tom/next swaps still trading at small premiums is the anticipation of Tuesday tax payments," the dealer said.
He said fears over possible large amount of tax payments to be submitted on Tuesday kept tom/next at 0.25/0.27.
Dealers said tax payments were usually high in mid-month and also due to the approaching fiscal year end at present.
Spot rupiah was at 2,383.75/84.25 at 0935 GMT against an opening of 2,382.5/83.5. Tomorrow closed at 2,383.4/83.7.
Another dealer said swap rates also eased across the board on excess rupiah supply except six-month swaps which were stable due to the upcoming general election on May 29.
One-month swap was at 12.00/12.75, two at 26.5/27.5, three at 38.75/39.00 and six at 78.5/79.0 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,378/2,570 and the conversion band at 2,378/2,426 on Monday.
The bank depreciated the rupiah by two points last week after lowering it by four points the previous week.
